title: Select Cargo
real_world_story: A logistics company has a vehicle with limited weight capacity and several packages with different weights and values. The company wants to select packages that maximize the total cargo value without exceeding the vehicle capacity.

real_world_connection.algorithm_represents: Selecting the most valuable combination of complete packages

problem_statement: Given N packages, each with a weight and value, select a subset of packages such that the total weight does not exceed the vehicle capacity C and the total value is maximized. Each package can be loaded at most once.
task: Find the maximum total value of packages that can be loaded into the vehicle.
input_format: The first line contains two integers N and C. The second line contains N integers representing package weights. The third line contains N integers representing package values.
output_format: Print the maximum total value that can be loaded without exceeding capacity C.

examples.explanation: Packages with weights 3 and 4 have values 50 and 60. Their total weight is 7 and their total value is 110, which is optimal.
The package with weight 4 and value 50 is the most valuable package that can be loaded within the capacity.

expected_algorithm.name: 0/1 Knapsack
expected_algorithm.reason: Each package must either be completely loaded or left behind, making the 0/1 Knapsack approach suitable.

hint: For every package, consider two choices: load it or skip it.
A package cannot be selected more than once.
Use dynamic programming to store the best value for each capacity.
real_world_takeaway: 0/1 Knapsack helps logistics systems choose the most valuable combination of complete packages when vehicle capacity is limited.
